about: Known client-visible Rust gaps found by client_rpc_parity.py against the pinned reference. Each case fails CI if it starts passing; remove it then. severity is for real client use: critical breaks a core flow, high breaks a feature, medium shows wrong data, low differs without visible effect.

attachments.assets.fetch.badToken.reason: rejected upload and asset URLs answer with an empty body
attachments.assets.fetch.badToken.issue: the reference answers 'Not Found' as text/plain

attachments.assets.fetchAttachment.reason: an uploaded attachment's asset URL returns 404
attachments.assets.fetchAttachment.issue: assets.createUrl for an uploaded attachment mints a URL Rust does not serve, so composer and transcript attachments do not load

attachments.assets.workspaceFile.reason: assets.createUrl for a draft image lacks imageDimensions
attachments.assets.workspaceFile.issue: the reference returns imageDimensions and omits fileRevision/sourcePath for draft-workspace-file images

attachments.upload.badToken.reason: rejected upload and asset URLs answer with an empty body
attachments.upload.badToken.issue: the reference answers 'Not Found' as text/plain

projects.filesystem.browse.reason: filesystem.browse keeps the trailing slash in parentPath
projects.filesystem.browse.issue: the reference normalizes parentPath to the directory without a trailing slash

projects.http.snapshot.afterDelete.reason: GET /api/projects still lists a deleted project
projects.http.snapshot.afterDelete.issue: the reference omits projects with deletedAt set

projects.listEntries.reason: projects.listEntries lists .git and gitignored paths, unsorted
projects.listEntries.issue: the reference walks only tracked and untracked-unignored files, sorted; Rust returns .git/*, target/ and build.log

projects.listEntries.missingCwd.reason: projects.listEntries succeeds with no entries for a missing cwd
projects.listEntries.missingCwd.issue: the reference fails with ProjectListEntriesError failure=workspace_root_not_found

projects.listIgnoredFiles.issue: the reference lists ignored files (build.log) with their byte length

projects.readFile.issue: extra key not in ProjectReadFileResult; the client ignores it, but replies differ

projects.readFile.afterWrite.issue: extra key not in ProjectReadFileResult; the client ignores it, but replies differ

projects.searchContents.reason: projects.searchContents returns empty matchRanges and searches ignored files
projects.searchContents.issue: the reference highlights each match and skips .git and gitignored files

projects.searchContents.regex.issue: a regex query matches nothing on Rust

projects.searchEntries.issue: for query 'read' the reference returns README.md, .gitignore, docs/guide.md and scratch.txt; Rust returns only README.md

projects.shellFollow.sawProject.reason: orchestration.subscribeShell sends nothing after its snapshot
projects.shellFollow.sawProject.issue: a live shell subscriber never receives project.updated or thread.updated after a mutation, so an open client's sidebar does not change until it reconnects

raw.projects.listEntries#3.reason: projects.listEntries lists .git and gitignored paths, unsorted
raw.projects.listEntries#3.issue: the reference walks only tracked and untracked-unignored files, sorted; Rust returns .git/*, target/ and build.log

raw.projects.listEntries#4.reason: projects.listEntries succeeds with no entries for a missing cwd
raw.projects.listEntries#4.issue: the reference fails with ProjectListEntriesError failure=workspace_root_not_found

raw.projects.readFile#5.issue: extra key not in ProjectReadFileResult; the client ignores it, but replies differ

raw.projects.readFile#6.reason: projects.readFile error for a missing file has a different operation and cause
raw.projects.readFile#6.issue: the reference reports operation realpath-target with a WorkspaceFileSystemOperationError cause; Rust reports read and an io error string

raw.projects.searchEntries#7.issue: for query 'read' the reference returns README.md, .gitignore, docs/guide.md and scratch.txt; Rust returns only README.md

settings.server.getStorageCleanupReport.issue: startedAt must be a string; the storage settings page cannot show the report

threads.getWorktreeThreadIds.reason: getWorktreeThreadIds matches threads by project root
threads.getWorktreeThreadIds.issue: the reference returns only threads whose worktreePath is the given path; Rust also returns local threads of the project at that root

threads.searchThread.reason: in-thread search replies have complete instead of navigation
threads.searchThread.issue: searchThread adds a complete field and searchThreadStream omits navigation, which the client uses to step through matches

threads.searchThreadStream.reason: in-thread search replies have complete instead of navigation
threads.searchThreadStream.issue: searchThread adds a complete field and searchThreadStream omits navigation, which the client uses to step through matches

threads.searchThreads.reason: orchestration.searchThreads replies fail the client's decode

threads.shellFollow.sawThread.reason: orchestration.subscribeShell sends nothing after its snapshot
threads.shellFollow.sawThread.issue: a live shell subscriber never receives project.updated or thread.updated after a mutation, so an open client's sidebar does not change until it reconnects

threads.threadFollow.sawRename.reason: a live subscribeThread answers a rename with a full snapshot (about 15 s later) instead of a thread.metadata-updated event
threads.threadFollow.sawRename.issue: the reference streams the metadata event within a few seconds of thread.meta.update

turns.getThreadProjection.afterMessage.reason: the projection after a message lacks the reference's provider runtime records and uses other ids
turns.getThreadProjection.afterMessage.issue: no attempts, nodes or providerThreads; runs have UUID ids, not run:thread:<id>:ordinal:<n>, and messages carry no nodeId; extra checkpoint and checkpointScope records

turns.message.missingProvider.reason: message.dispatch accepts a disabled provider instance
turns.message.missingProvider.issue: the reference rejects the command with OrchestrationV2DispatchCommandError (provider instance disabled for the project); Rust records it and replies with a sequence

turns.subscribeCommandOutput.missing.reason: subscribeCommandOutput for an unknown item streams an empty replace

vcs.refreshStatus.issue: the reference compares the branch with its upstream origin/main; Rust reports baseRef null

vcs.removeWorktree.reason: vcs.removeWorktree fails on a worktree vcs.createWorktree made
vcs.removeWorktree.issue: git worktree remove exits 128 on Rust; the reference removes it

vcs.review.getDiffPreview.issue: the review panel's file list needs changeType for each file

vcs.subscribeVcsStatus.issue: the reference compares the branch with its upstream origin/main; Rust reports baseRef null

vcs.subscribeVcsStatus.remote.issue: the reference compares the branch with its upstream origin/main; Rust reports baseRef null
